purpose: README previews: sped-up, downscaled animated WebP cut from recorded runs. outputs/ is not committed, so regenerate these after the scene or an expert changes.
method: PyAV decodes the MP4 and keeps every `step`-th frame and the last; Pillow resizes it (LANCZOS) and writes a lossy animated WebP (quality 70, method 6), 80 ms per frame, the last frame held 1.5 s, looping. Speed = step x 40 ms / 80 ms.

kitting.webp.source: outputs/kitting_demo_urdf_seed7/expert.mp4 on the pro6000 (overview with both wrist D405 insets)
kitting.webp.episode: wheel_robot_26.8.16_3, single-arm subtasks; seed 7, 111.9 s, 6/6 parts placed, no collision; the shortest seed of outputs/kitting_check_urdf_v1

cameras.webp.source: outputs/kitting_demo_urdf_seed7/cameras.mp4 (2x2 mosaic of the four policy cameras)

scenes.webp.purpose: README scene gallery: one body_d435 tile per scene, 5 per row, labelled with the scene package name
scenes.webp.method: Each 640x480 body_d435 frame is cropped to its bottom 640x320 (the plain wall above the table dropped), resized to 320x160 (LANCZOS) and labelled in Arial Bold 15 on a translucent black box; tiles 4 px apart; lossy WebP quality 82, method 6.

row_1.pick_place: outputs/pp_urdf_rec/body_d435.mp4, frame 850 (the blue part on its pad, the right hand setting the orange one down)
row_1.kitting: outputs/kitting_demo_urdf_seed7/body_d435.mp4, frame 2600 (the right hand placing the last part)
row_1.robosyn_kitchen, robosyn_drawer, robosyn: seed 0 in the default posture (tabletop.start_home), rendered from body_d435: their experts are not redone on wheel_robot_26.8.16_3 yet

scenes.webp.rows_2_3_start_state: the body_d435 panel (x 0-640, y 520-1000) of outputs/urdf_bench_<scene>/preview.png, the scene checks on wheel_robot_26.8.16_3 (2026-10-25), in docs/benchmark.md order

pick_place.webp.used_in: docs/tasks.md, pick-and-place section (no longer in the README)
pick_place.webp.source: outputs/pp_urdf_rec/expert.mp4 on the pro6000 (overview with both wrist D405 insets)
pick_place.webp.episode: wheel_robot_26.8.16_3, single-arm subtasks: 43.3 s, both parts placed; the current pick-and-place reference run

isaac_tote_transfer.webp.purpose: docs/isaac.md: the MuJoCo (top) and Isaac Sim 5.1 (bottom) scene-check previews of tote_transfer after the 4 s settle
isaac_tote_transfer.webp.made_with: python -m isaac.export tote_transfer --output outputs/isaac_bench_v1, then isaac/run.sh isaac.check outputs/isaac_bench_v1/tote_transfer
isaac_tote_transfer.webp.method: Pillow resize to 1280 px wide (LANCZOS), lossy WebP quality 80, method 6
